data.name: Darcy
data.gender_notes: Darcy is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Darcy is derived from the Old English name Dærecy, which is composed of two parts: ‘dær’ meaning ‘dear’ and ‘cy’ meaning ‘sea’ or ‘lake’. The name Darcy can be interpreted as ‘dear one’ or ‘little dark one’. The name is synonymous with courage, bravery, and strength. The name Darcy carries the meaning “Daring, Brave” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Darcy usually hope their child will grow to embody daring, brave and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Darcy is a name that represents inner strength, resilience, and the ability to overcome challenges with courage and grace. It is a name that evokes a sense of determination and perseverance, and is often associated with those who are bold and fearless in their pursuit of their dreams and goals.
